proposals.evidence: Turner4939 directly gives Shumashti ċō di go and neighboring Dardic čō go/imperative. Buddruss pairs Shumashti co with Grangali ca-, supplying a Grangali present and preterite to show it is a verbal stem; these forms belong to the local c- go family, without assigning the whole inflectional paradigm to a single ancestral tense. Reviewed source audit and import row matched; no transcription or identity changes.

proposals.evidence: Turner11004 directly gives Shumashti lā̆y- beat/strike and neighbouring Ashkun lā- beat. Buddruss pairs Shumashti lay- with Grangali la- and gives Grangali present and preterite forms. The source stem spellings are preserved without claiming a precise tense derivation. Reviewed source audit and import row matched; no transcription or identity changes.
